method: llm_inference --dumpProfile --warmup 1, TRT-reported GPU time per stage; frames = robovqa_0_*.jpg at <=448px
note_plugin: EDGELLM_PLUGIN_PATH must be exported explicitly; ~/.bashrc returns early for non-interactive shells, and the relative fallback path only resolves when cwd is the TensorRT-Edge-LLM dir
repeatability: 6-frame vision encoder measured 144.52 ms and 146.17 ms on two runs (1.1% apart)

constraints.implication: 112 image tokens/frame => at most 8 frames (896 tokens) plus a short prompt fit; 9+ frames requires rebuilding the LLM engine with a larger maxInputLen

caveats.decode_number_unused: llm_inference reports 'Average Time per Token: ~16.3 ms' for generation, but that divides a single decode step's GPU time (32.93 ms) by 'Generated Tokens: 2' (which counts the prefill-produced first token). 32.93 ms matches llm_bench's 33.13 ms E2E TPOT, so TPOT is reported from llm_bench, not from this field.
caveats.peak_memory_scope: Peak unified memory is ~4856 MB regardless of frame count and ~equals the LLM engine size alone, so this counter appears to exclude the separately-loaded visual engine; reported verbatim, scope not confirmed.
caveats.int8_vision_blocked: visual_build exposes no precision flag (only onnxDir/engineDir/token limits) => the vision tower's fp16 precision is fixed by the exported ONNX. Quantizing it requires re-exporting in the cloud (Kaggle), which needs the HF/Kaggle credentials pending rotation.
